projects.title: ML-Based Trading Strategy (Flagship Project)
projects.description: Build, backtest, and evaluate a machine learning trading strategy with proper methodology. This is your #1 portfolio project.
actionSteps: Write alpha thesis: WHY should this strategy work? What market inefficiency are you exploiting?
Collect data: OHLCV, fundamentals, macro indicators, sentiment scores
Feature engineering: 50+ features, each with financial justification (momentum, mean-reversion, volatility, volume)
Implement proper walk-forward validation: train on 2 years, test on 6 months, roll forward
Train multiple models: XGBoost, LightGBM, Neural Network — compare with statistical tests
Implement position sizing with Kelly criterion or fractional Kelly
Model transaction costs: commission, slippage, market impact
Add regime detection: strategy adapts based on volatility regime (HMM or clustering)
Calculate all metrics: Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, Calmar, win rate, profit factor
Create professional visualizations: equity curve, drawdown chart, monthly returns heatmap
Write 5-10 page research report with methodology, results, and honest limitations
Add unit tests for core logic, document everything in README
whatMakesItImpressive: Alpha thesis shows you think about WHY, not just HOW
Walk-forward validation proves you understand time series pitfalls
Transaction cost modeling shows production awareness
Regime detection shows sophistication
Research report shows communication skills
Unit tests show engineering maturity
